title: Systems approach to nitrogen modeling in the Chesapeake Bay: Advancing production chain analysis under future changes
Achieving Resilience Amidst Crises in U.S. Dairies: The Importance of Sustainability Investments and Women in Farming
Revealing Fundamental Demand Parameters: A New Theoretically Consistent Meta-Regression Approach to US Food Demand Elasticities
A Meta-Analysis of U.S. Food Demand Elasticities to Detect the Impacts of Scanner Data
Impacts of Future Scenarios on the Nitrogen Loss from Agricultural Supply Chains in the Chesapeake Bay
abstract: Excessive nitrogen (N) pollution in the Chesapeake Bay is threatening ecological health. This study presents a multilayer N flow network model where each network layer represents a stage in the production step from raw agricultural commodities such as corn to final products such as packaged meat. We use this model to assess the impacts of alternative future agricultural production and land use changes on multiple pathways of N pollution within the Chesapeake Bay Watershed (CBW). We analyzed N loss via all pathways under multiple future scenarios, considering crop-specific projections based on empirical data and US Department of Agriculture projections. We found two model parameters, fertilizer nitrogen application rate (FNAR) and feed conversion ratio (FCR), to be particularly important for seeing measurable N loss reductions in the Bay. Our results indicate a large increase in N loss under the business-as-usual trajectory in geographic locations with intensive agricultural production. We found that numerous management scenarios including improvements in FNAR and FCR, N losses fall short of the 25% total maximum daily load targets. Our work suggests that achieving the CBW N loss reduction goals will necessitate large deviations from business as usual. Our model also highlights substantial regional variations in nitrogen loss across the U.S., with central regions like the Corn Belt and Central Valley of California experiencing the highest losses from crop-related stages, while eastern areas such as the Chesapeake Bay exhibit major losses from live animal production, underscoring the need for region-specific management strategies. Thus, implementation of effective N management strategies, combined with improved crop residue management, remains pivotal in mitigating N pollution in the Chesapeake Bay.
abstract_zh: 切萨皮克湾过量的氮（N）污染正威胁生态健康。本研究提出了一个多层氮流网络模型，其中每个网络层代表从玉米等原始农产品到包装肉类等最终产品的生产环节之一。我们利用该模型评估未来农业生产与土地利用变化对切萨皮克湾流域（CBW）内多条氮污染路径的影响。我们在多种未来情景下分析了所有路径的氮流失，考虑了基于经验数据的作物特异性预测以及美国农业部（USDA）的预测。我们发现，两个模型参数（施肥氮用量FNAR和饲料转化比FCR）对于在海湾实现可测量的氮流失减少尤为重要。我们的结果表明，在农业生产密集的地区，若维持照常发展（business-as-usual）路径，氮流失将大幅增加。我们发现，包括改善FNAR和FCR在内的多种管理情景下，氮流失仍未达到总日最大负荷（TMDL）规定的25%减排目标。我们的工作表明，要实现CBW的氮流失削减目标，必须大幅偏离照常发展的路径。我们的模型还凸显了美国各地区氮流失的显著差异：玉米带和加州中央谷等中部地区在作物相关环节的流失量最高，而切萨皮克湾等东部地区则在活体动物生产环节产生较大流失，这突显了因地制宜制定管理策略的必要性。因此，结合作物秸秆的改进管理，有效的氮管理策略的实施对于减轻切萨皮克湾的氮污染仍然至关重要。

title: Dairy Pricing Policy, Production, and Water Quality: Application to the Chesapeake Bay Watershed
venue: Journal of the Agricultural & Applied Economics Association
abstract: This study assesses the economic and water quality impacts of implementing a dairy pricing policy under Federal Milk Marketing Order system designed to alleviate milk prices plummet occurred at the beginning of pandemic. Using a 12‐region, positive mathematical programing model of livestock production in the Chesapeake Bay watershed, we find that pricing policy induces significant expansions in dairy sectors, generates higher level of total net revenue in regions having large base‐period dairy sectors. For water quality, we find that policy leads to an increase in nitrogen emissions but a decrease in phosphorus emissions for the livestock industry as a whole in most studied regions.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了在《联邦牛奶市场秩序》体系下实施的乳制品定价政策对经济和水质的影响，该政策旨在缓解疫情初期牛奶价格暴跌的问题。我们使用覆盖切萨皮克湾流域、包含12个地区的正数规划（positive mathematical programming）畜牧生产模型，发现定价政策引发了乳业部门的显著扩张，并在基期乳业规模较大的地区产生了更高的总净收入。就水质而言，我们发现，在大多数研究地区，该政策使整个畜牧业的氮排放增加，而磷排放减少。

title: Effects of Aging on Labor-Intensive Crop Production from the Perspectives of Landform and Life Cycle Labor Supply: Evidence from Chinese Apple Growers
abstract: The aging of the agricultural labor force is an irreversible trend that has become an important issue in China’s economic transformation. Previous studies on the effects of an aging population in developing countries on agriculture mainly focused on food crops, and the conclusions were mixed. Using data for apple growers in Shaanxi Province, China, we used ordinary least squares (OLS), stochastic frontier production function (SFA), and truncated regression to investigate how rural aging affects apple production under different landform conditions. We provided evidence that (i) aging leads apple growers to use hired labor to replace family labor in the flatlands, but not in mountainous and hilly areas, due to landform constraints on the factor substitution; (ii) aging has no significant impact on mechanical inputs in either the plains or the mountains, indicating that machinery cannot effectively replace the labor force; (iii) limited by a shortage of labor quantity and quality, apple growers respond to aging by reducing agricultural inputs in mountainous and hilly areas; (iv) changes in input structure cause aging to have little influence on yield and technical efficiency in flatlands, while aging significantly reduces yield in mountainous and hilly areas; (v) there is a nonlinear relationship between aging and technical efficiency and yield; and (vi) because the overall mechanization level of China’s apple industry is low, mechanical substitution for labor is not common in apple production.
abstract_zh: 农业劳动力老龄化是一种不可逆转的趋势，已成为中国经济转型中的一个重要问题。以往关于发展中国家人口老龄化对农业影响的研究主要集中于粮食作物，且结论不一。我们利用陕西省苹果种植户的数据，运用普通最小二乘法（OLS）、随机前沿生产函数（SFA）和截断回归，考察了在不同地貌条件下农村老龄化如何影响苹果生产。我们提供了如下证据：（i）由于地貌对要素替代的约束，老龄化促使平原地区的果农以雇佣劳动替代家庭劳动，而山地和丘陵地区则没有这一现象；（ii）无论在平原还是山地，老龄化对机械投入均无显著影响，表明机械无法有效替代劳动力；（iii）受劳动力数量和质量短缺的限制，果农在山地和丘陵地区通过减少农业投入来应对老龄化；（iv）投入结构的变化使老龄化对平原地区的产量和技术效率影响甚微，而老龄化则显著降低了山地和丘陵地区的产量；（v）老龄化与技术效率和产量之间存在非线性关系；（vi）由于中国苹果产业的整体机械化水平较低，机械替代劳动在苹果生产中并不普遍。

title: Heterogeneity in US Farms: A New Clustering by Production Potentials
abstract: This paper uses agglomerative hierarchical cluster analysis to group 2778 farming-defined counties into six clusters, revealing farm patterns across the contiguous 48 states of the United States. To understand the differences in economic performance and improve farm households’ well-being, economists have endeavored to identify patterns in US farming. The US is a leading global producer and exporter of many agricultural and food products. Our primary objective is to construct a policy-relevant farm clustering to characterize agricultural homogeneity in US farms’ production potential. We identify six clusters that are relatively homogeneous in five dimensions: farm size, farm assets, farm labor, farm output, degree of mechanization, and government programs. Minimizing diversity within a cluster allows for analysis of public policy changes on specific clusters and comparison of differential effects of the change across clusters.
abstract_zh: 本文采用凝聚式层次聚类分析，将2778个以农业为界定标准的县划分为六类，揭示了美国本土48州的农业格局。为了理解经济绩效的差异并改善农户福祉，经济学家一直致力于识别美国农业的模式。美国是众多农产品和食品的全球主要生产国和出口国。我们的主要目标是构建一个与政策相关的农业聚类，以刻画美国农场生产潜力的农业同质性。我们识别出六个聚类，它们在五个维度上相对同质：农场规模、农场资产、农业劳动力、农业产出、机械化程度以及政府计划。最小化聚类内部的差异，有助于分析特定聚类中的公共政策变化，并比较该变化在不同聚类之间的差异化效应。

title: Crop Allocation and Increasing Returns to Fertilizer Use in China
abstract: This study sheds light on the effects of crop allocation on economic returns to chemical fertilizer in Chinese agriculture and attempts to explain the increasing trend of aggregate fertilizer use from a different angle even though the government tried to limit the application. We show in theory and through simulation and empirical analyses that while the marginal product of fertilizer is declining at the intensive margin (for a specific crop), this may be offset by an increasing marginal product of fertilizer at the extensive margin (due to shifts in the structure of crops produced).
abstract_zh: 本研究揭示了作物结构配置对中国农业化肥经济回报的影响，并试图从另一个角度解释尽管政府试图限制施用，化肥总用量仍呈上升趋势的现象。我们从理论上并通过模拟和实证分析表明：虽然化肥在集约边际（特定作物）上的边际产出是递减的，但这一递减可能会被外延边际上化肥边际产出的递增所抵消（这源于所产作物结构的转变）。

Do Farmer Professional Cooperatives Improve Technical Efficiency and Income? Evidence from Small Vegetable Farms in China
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: China’s small-scale agricultural producers face many challenges to increasing productivity and efficiency. In recent years, the Chinese government has provided support for farmer professional cooperatives (FPCs) to connect small farms with upstream and downstream processes in the food supply chain. This study combines propensity score matching and sample selection-corrected stochastic production frontier analysis to estimate the impacts of FPC participation by greenhouse vegetable producers on technical efficiency and income. Results indicate that FPCs help participants improve returns to scale and marginal returns to land and labor, increase technical efficiency, and obtain ¥4,460 (18%) greater income per greenhouse than nonparticipants.
abstract_zh: 中国的小规模农业生产者在提高生产率和效率方面面临诸多挑战。近年来，中国政府支持农民专业合作社（FPCs），以将小农户与食品供应链中的上下游环节相连接。本研究结合倾向得分匹配与纠正样本选择偏误的随机生产前沿分析，估计了温室蔬菜生产者参与农民专业合作社对技术效率和收入的影响。结果表明，农民专业合作社有助于参与者改善规模报酬以及土地和劳动的边际报酬，提高技术效率，并使每个温室的收入比非参与者高出4,460元（18%）。

title: Consumer Preferences and Welfare Evaluation under Current Food Inspection Measures in China: Evidence from Real Experiment Choice of Rice Labels
A Meta-Analysis of Food Demand Elasticities for China

Matching Food with Mouths: A Statistical Explanation to the Abnormal Decline of Per Capita Food Consumption in Rural China
Economic Evaluation of Agricultural Pollution Control Options for China
abstract: Environmental sustainability has become a policy priority in China. In agriculture, China has had major success in rehabilitating desertified lands through programs to convert steeply-sloped cropland to forest and limit grazing on sensitive grasslands. However, little has been done in terms of policies for agricultural nutrient management. Runoff and leaching of nutrients in chemical fertilizers and livestock manure are widely acknowledged as significant problems in China. This paper presents an evaluation of agricultural nonpoint pollution control options for China. Options analyzed include design standards (command & control), performance standards, and design and performance incentives. Evaluation criteria include economic efficiency and effectiveness, environmental impact and risk, and social criteria such as equity and food security. The evaluation indicates that the best options for China involve subsidies to farmers for changing production practices in order to reduce nonpoint emissions, combined with appropriate farmer education and technical assistance.
abstract_zh: 环境可持续性已成为中国的政策优先事项。在农业领域，中国通过实施将陡坡耕地转为林地、限制敏感草原放牧等项目，在荒漠化土地治理方面取得了重大成就。然而，在农业养分管理政策方面所做的工作仍然很少。化肥和畜禽粪便中养分的径流与淋溶被普遍认为是中国面临的重大问题。本文对中国农业面源污染控制方案进行了评估。所分析的方案包括设计标准（命令-控制型）、绩效标准，以及设计和绩效激励。评估标准包括经济效率和有效性、环境影响与风险，以及公平和粮食安全等社会标准。评估结果表明，对中国而言，最佳方案是向农户提供补贴，激励其改变生产方式以减少面源排放，并辅以适当的农户教育和技术援助。

title: Agricultural Costs of the Chesapeake Bay Total Maximum Daily Load
abstract: This study estimates costs to agricultural producers of the Watershed Implementation Plans (WIPs) developed by states in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed to comply with the Chesapeake Bay total maximum daily load (TMDL) and potential cost savings that could be realized by a more efficient selection of agricultural Best Management Practices (BMPs) and spatial targeting of BMP implementation. The cost of implementing the WIPs between 2011 and 2025 is estimated to be about $3.6 billion (in 2010 dollars). The annual cost associated with full implementation of all WIP BMPs from 2025 onward is about $900 million. Significant cost savings can be realized through careful and efficient BMP selection and spatial targeting. If retiring up to 25% of current agricultural land is included as an option, Bay-wide cost savings of about 60% could be realized compared to the WIPs.
abstract_zh: 本研究估计了切萨皮克湾流域各州为遵守切萨皮克湾总日最大负荷（TMDL）而制定的流域实施计划（WIPs）对农业生产者造成的成本，以及通过更有效地选择农业最佳管理措施（BMPs）并对BMP实施进行空间靶向所可能实现的成本节约。2011至2025年间实施WIPs的成本约为36亿美元（按2010年美元计）。自2025年起，全面实施所有WIP BMPs的年度成本约为9亿美元。通过审慎、高效地选择BMP并进行空间靶向，可实现显著的成本节约。若将退出最多25%的现有农用地作为一种选项纳入，相较于WIPs，全流域可实现约60%的成本节约。

title: Densified Biomass Can Cost-Effectively Mitigate Greenhouse Gas Emissions and Address Energy Security in Thermal Applications
abstract: Regional supplies of biomass are currently being evaluated as feedstocks in energy applications to meet renewable portfolio (RPS) and low carbon fuel standards. We investigate the life cycle greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and associated abatement costs resulting from using densified switchgrass for thermal and electrical energy. In contrast to the large and positive abatement costs for using biomass in electricity generation ($149/Mg CO(2)e) due to the low cost of coal and high feedstock and power plant operation costs, abatement costs for replacing fuel oil with biomass in thermal applications are large and negative (-$52 to -$92/Mg CO(2)e), resulting in cost savings. Replacing fuel oil with biomass in thermal applications results in least cost reductions compared to replacing coal in electricity generation, an alternative that has gained attention due to RPS legislation and the centralized production model most often considered in U.S. policy. Our estimates indicate a more than doubling of liquid fuel displacement when switchgrass is substituted for fuel oil as opposed to gasoline, suggesting that, in certain U.S. locations, such as the northeast, densified biomass would help to significantly decarbonize energy supply with regionally sourced feedstock, while also reducing imported oil. On the basis of supply projections from the recently released Billion Ton Report, there will be enough sustainably harvested biomass available in the northeast by 2022 to offset the entirety of heating oil demand in the same region. This will save NE consumers between $2.3 and $3.9 billion annually. Diverting the same resource to electricity generation would cost the region $7.7 billion per year. While there is great need for finding low carbon substitutes for coal power and liquid transportation fuels in the U.S., we argue that in certain regions it makes cost- (and GHG mitigation-) effective sense to phase out liquid heating fuels with locally produced biomass first.
abstract_zh: 生物质的区域供应目前正被评估为能源应用的原料，以满足可再生能源组合标准（RPS）和低碳燃料标准。我们研究了使用致密化柳枝稷用于热能和电能所产生的全生命周期温室气体（GHG）排放及相关减排成本。与将生物质用于发电的大额正减排成本（149美元/吨CO2e）形成对比（后者源于煤炭价格低廉以及原料和电厂运营成本高昂），将生物质替代热应用中的燃料油，其减排成本则为大额负值（-52至-92美元/吨CO2e），即可带来成本节约。与替代发电中的煤炭相比，在热应用中用生物质替代燃料油所实现的减排成本最低；替代发电中的煤炭因RPS立法以及美国政策中最常考虑的集中化生产模式而受到关注。我们的估计表明，用柳枝稷替代燃料油而非汽油时，液体燃料的替代量会增加一倍以上，这表明在美国某些地区（如东北部），致密化生物质有助于利用区域性原料显著实现能源供应脱碳，同时减少石油进口。根据最近发布的《十亿吨报告》（Billion Ton Report）的供应预测，到2022年，东北部将有足够的可持续采伐生物质，可完全抵消该地区的取暖油需求。这将使东北部消费者每年节省23亿至39亿美元。若将同样的资源用于发电，该地区每年将付出77亿美元的成本。尽管美国迫切需要为煤电和液体交通燃料寻找低碳替代品，但我们认为，在某些地区，优先以本地生产的生物质逐步淘汰液体取暖燃料，在成本和温室气体减排两方面都更为有效。

title: A Review of Empirical Studies of the Acreage and Production Response to US Production Flexibility Contract Payments under the Fair Act and Related Payments under Supplementary Legislation
The `Efficient But Poor' Hypothesis
Value of Information for Water Quality Management
abstract: There is now much interest in comprehensive watershed‐based approaches to water quality protection. While there is much to be said in favor of such an approach, it is also clear that implementation requires information that is often lacking. Given that information acquisition is costly, decisions are required about the types and amounts of information that should be sought. We examine the expected value of different types of information for price and quantity instruments for agricultural nitrogen pollution control in the Susquehanna River Basin. We also compare the ex ante economic efficiency of price and quantity instruments. The analysis explicitly accounts for public sector uncertainty about the benefits and costs of pollution reductions, with economic efficiency measured as the expected benefits less the expected costs of pollution reductions. We find optimized price controls to outperform optimized quantity controls under a range of possible information structures. For both instruments, information collection improves policy performance, with information about the benefits of pollution reductions having the greatest impact. The performance of the quantity instrument is more sensitive to information than is the price instrument. In consequence, the value of information to reduce benefit and cost uncertainty is greater for the quantity control.
abstract_zh: 目前人们对基于流域的综合水质保护方法颇感兴趣。尽管这种方法优点颇多，但其实施需要的信息往往十分缺乏。鉴于信息获取成本高昂，需要决定应寻求何种类型以及多少信息。我们考察了在萨斯奎汉纳河流域，针对农业氮污染控制的价格型与数量型工具，不同类型信息的期望价值。我们还比较了两类工具的事前经济效率。分析明确考虑了公共部门对减排效益和成本的不确定性，经济效率以减排的期望效益减去期望成本衡量。我们发现，在一系列可能的信息结构下，经过优化的价格控制都优于经过优化的数量控制。对于两类工具而言，信息收集都能改善政策绩效，其中关于减排效益的信息影响最大。数量工具的绩效比价格工具对信息更为敏感。因此，降低效益和成本不确定性的信息价值，对数量控制而言更大。

title: Climate Change and Pennsylvania Agriculture
Multifunctionality, Agricultural Policy, and Environmental Policy
abstract: In addition to supplying food and fiber, agriculture is a source of public goods and externalities. This article addresses two questions. First, do price and income support policies promote a multifunctional agriculture in an effective manner? Second, would policies targeted more directly at multifunctional attributes be more efficient than price and income support policies? The answer to the first question is no, at least for policies targeted at outputs (price supports, export subsidies, etc.). Public goods are not directly linked to production, but rather to land use and agricultural structures. Evidence in response to the second question is sketchier with respect to policies targeted at land.
abstract_zh: 除提供食物和纤维外，农业还是公共物品和外部性的来源。本文探讨两个问题。第一，价格和收入支持政策能否以有效方式促进多功能农业？第二，针对多功能属性更直接设计的政策，是否会比价格和收入支持政策更有效率？对于第一个问题，答案是否定的，至少对于针对产出的政策（价格支持、出口补贴等）而言是如此。公共物品并非直接与生产相关，而是与土地利用和农业结构相关。对于第二个问题，针对土地的政策所提供的证据则较为零散。

title: The Coordination and Design of Point-Nonpoint Trading Programs and Agri-Environmental Policies
abstract: Agricultural agencies have long offered agri-environmental payments that are inadequate to achieve water quality goals, and many state water quality agencies are considering point-nonpoint trading to achieve the needed pollution reductions. This analysis considers both targeted and nontargeted agri-environmental payment schemes, along with a trading program which is not spatially targeted. The degree of improved performance among these policies is found to depend on whether the programs are coordinated or not, whether double-dipping (i.e., when farmers are paid twice—once by each program—to undertake particular pollution control actions) is allowed, and whether the agri-environmental payments are targeted. Under coordination, efficiency gains only occur with double-dipping, so that both programs jointly influence farmers’ marginal decisions. Without coordination, double-dipping may increase or decrease efficiency, depending on how the agri-environmental policy is targeted. Finally, double-dipping may not solely benefit farmers, but can result in a transfer of agricultural subsidies to point sources.
abstract_zh: 农业部门长期以来提供的农业环境支付不足以实现水质目标，许多州水质机构正在考虑通过点源-面源排污权交易来实现所需的污染削减。本分析同时考虑了有针对性和无针对性的农业环境支付方案，以及一项不进行空间靶向的交易方案。研究发现，这些政策的绩效改善程度取决于项目是否协调、是否允许重复补贴（即农民因同一项污染控制行为而从两个项目各获得一次补偿），以及农业环境支付是否具有针对性。在协调的情况下，只有允许重复补贴时才会产生效率收益，因为两个项目共同影响农民的边际决策。在不协调的情况下，重复补贴可能提高或降低效率，取决于农业环境政策的靶向方式。最后，重复补贴未必只使农民受益，还可能导致农业补贴转移给点源排放者。

Characterizing Regional Economic Impacts and Responses to Climate Change
Climate Change and Agriculture in the Mid-Atlantic Region
abstract: Agriculture in the Mid-Atlantic Region, like agriculture worldwide, has an intrinsic relationship with climate. This article considers how climate change might affect future Mid-Atlantic agriculture. Our assessment differs from prior work in 2 important ways. First, prior assessments have for the most part examined the impacts of future climate change on present-day agriculture, neglecting the fact that agriculture is likely to change dramatically in the coming century independent of climate change. Second, previous assessments have focused almost exclusively on the impacts of climate change on agricultural production. Societal interest in agriculture, however, is much broader than production because agriculture is a source of both rural amenities and negative environmental impacts. Our assessment suggests that Mid-Atlantic crop and livestock production will probably not change significantly in either direction. There might be changes in the environmental impacts of agricultural production and land use, but we currently lack evidence on the magnitudes and even directions of these changes. Given that agriculture currently has significant negative impacts on water quality in many areas, including the Chesapeake Bay, this should be a high priority for research. In addition, research is needed to understand climate impacts on agriculture's contributions to wildlife habitat, rural landscape amenities and carbon sequestration.
abstract_zh: 与全球其他地区的农业一样，大西洋中部地区的农业与气候之间存在内在联系。本文考察了气候变化可能如何影响未来大西洋中部地区的农业。我们的评估与以往研究有两点重要不同。第一，以往评估大多考察未来气候变化对当今农业的影响，忽视了农业在本世纪将独立于气候变化而发生显著变化这一事实。第二，以往评估几乎完全聚焦于气候变化对农业生产的影响。然而，社会对农业的关注远不止于生产，因为农业既是乡村景观价值的来源，也是负面环境影响的来源。我们的评估表明，大西洋中部地区的作物和畜禽生产在任一方向上都可能不会发生显著变化。农业生产和土地利用的环境影响可能会发生变化，但我们目前缺乏关于这些变化的幅度乃至方向的证据。鉴于农业目前已对包括切萨皮克湾在内的许多地区的水质产生显著负面影响，这应当成为研究的高度优先事项。此外，还需要研究气候对农业在野生动物栖息地、乡村景观价值和碳固存方面贡献的影响。

title: Green Payments for Nonpoint Pollution Control

Trade Liberalization and the Environment in Costa Rica
abstract: This study examines the environmental impacts of trade liberalization in Costa Rica. A CGE model is constructed which includes eight environmental indicators covering deforestation, pesticides, overfishing, hazardous wastes, inorganic wastes, organic wastes, greenhouse gases, and air pollution. Three trade liberalization scenarios are examined. Two sets of analyses are conducted for each scenario, one in which technologies do not change in response to trade liberalization and the other in which total factor productivity in each sector changes in response to changes in imports of machinery and equipment. To account for uncertainty regarding values of the model's parameters, a Monte Carlo experiment is conducted for each policy option. The impacts of trade liberalization on the environmental indicators are generally negative in sign but small or moderate in magnitude, both when technology is constant and when technology is allowed to vary.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了哥斯达黎加贸易自由化的环境影响。我们构建了一个可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，纳入了八项环境指标，涵盖森林砍伐、农药、过度捕捞、危险废物、无机废物、有机废物、温室气体和空气污染。我们考察了三种贸易自由化情景。对每种情景进行了两组分析：一组假定技术不因贸易自由化而改变，另一组则假定各部门的全要素生产率会随机器和设备进口的变化而改变。为考虑模型参数取值的不确定性，我们对每种政策选项进行了蒙特卡洛实验。贸易自由化对各项环境指标的影响在方向上总体为负，但幅度较小或中等，无论技术是否保持不变，还是允许其变化，结论均是如此。

abstract: In this paper we consider the market‐level impacts of factor‐augmenting innovations designed to reduce the use of fertilizers and pesticides, first within the context of a simple two‐factor model, and then through a simulation model of the U.S. corn market. In both models, the impacts depend on the output demand elasticity and input substitution elasticities. The principal conclusion of the simulation analysis is that the potential for new techniques to reduce the use of agricultural chemicals is limited. Capital‐augmenting innovations would actually raise fertilizer and pesticide usage. Land‐augmenting innovations would also tend to increase pesticide usage.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了旨在减少化肥和农药使用的要素增强型创新对市场层面的影响，首先在一个简单的两要素模型框架内进行分析，然后通过美国玉米市场的模拟模型进行研究。在两个模型中，影响都取决于产出需求弹性和投入替代弹性。模拟分析的主要结论是：新技术减少农用化学品使用的潜力是有限的。资本增强型创新实际上会增加化肥和农药的使用。土地增强型创新也倾向于增加农药使用。

title: The Allocation of LISA Research and Extension Funding
The Economic Performance of Alternative Agricultural Nonpoint Pollution Controls
Production Technologies in Ethiopian Agriculture
abstract: This article examines the characteristics of and choice among two production technologies in Ethiopian agriculture, one with fertilizer and the other without, using 1989-90 farm-level data. For northwest and central Ethiopia, fertilizer usage determinants are estimated simultaneously with technology-specific production functions. For southern Ethiopia, where fertilizer is rarely used, a single production function is estimated. Three conclusions emerge. First, fertilizer use is not significantly affected by a farm's stocks of capital or land. This is consistent with the fact that fertilizer allocation decisions under the deposed Mengistu regime were politicized to the point where farmers had little control over use. Second, fertilizer is associated with a smaller factor share for cattle and a larger share for land, meaning that those who control land may gain relative to the individual farmers who own cattle as the country develops agriculturally. Third, farms without fertilizer in northwest and central Ethiopia tend to be too small, a problem due to population pressures on the land and communal methods of land allocation. This suggests that land allocation institutions should adjust by distributing land to a smaller but more economically viable number of farmers.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1989–90年的农户层面数据，考察了埃塞俄比亚农业中两种生产技术（一种使用化肥，另一种不使用化肥）的特征及其选择。在埃塞俄比亚西北部和中部，化肥使用的决定因素与技术特定的生产函数被同时估计。在化肥很少使用的埃塞俄比亚南部，则估计了单一的生产函数。研究得出三点结论。第一，化肥使用并不受农户资本或土地存量的显著影响。这与以下事实相一致：在被推翻的门格斯图政权下，化肥分配决策高度政治化，农民几乎无法控制其使用。第二，使用化肥与牲畜的要素份额较小、与土地的要素份额较大相关，这意味着随着国家农业发展，控制土地的人相对于拥有牲畜的个体农民可能获益更多。第三，在埃塞俄比亚西北部和中部，不使用化肥的农场往往规模过小，这是人口压力和集体土地分配方式所造成的问题。这表明，土地分配制度应当调整，将土地分配给数量更少但经济上更可行的农户。

title: NAFTA, Agriculture and the Environment in Mexico
NAFTA, Agriculture, and the Environment
Environmental and Farm Commodity Policy Linkages in the US and EC
abstract: This paper analyses restrictions on agricultural chemicals in the US and the EC under various farm commodity policy scenarios using a partial equilibrium simulation model. The model has three regions (US, EC, rest of the world) and four commodities (wheat, maize, coarse grains, soybeans). Medium- and long-run impacts are derived. Given existing farm programmes, US landowners gain from chemical restrictions while EC landowners generally lose. Given bilateral elimination of farm programmes, both US and EC landowners gain from chemical restrictions. Bilateral farm programme elimination without chemical restrictions induces a shift in chemical usage from the EC to the US.
abstract_zh: 本文利用局部均衡模拟模型，分析了在多种农产品政策情景下，美国和欧共体（EC）对农用化学品的限制。该模型包含三个地区（美国、欧共体、世界其他地区）和四种商品（小麦、玉米、粗粮、大豆）。文中推导了中期和长期影响。在现有农业计划下，美国土地所有者从化学品限制中获益，而欧共体土地所有者总体上则受损。在双边取消农业计划的情况下，美国和欧共体的土地所有者都会从化学品限制中获益。在不实施化学品限制的情况下双边取消农业计划，会导致化学品使用量从欧共体向美国转移。

Differential Returns to Labor in Indian Agriculture
venue: Northeastern Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: This article explores the speed of adjustment in Indian agricultural labor markets to changing economic circumstances. Agricultural wages in sixteen states during 1970–86 are analyzed. Results indicate that agricultural wages adjust quickly toward their long-run values, completing about one-fifth to one-fourth of the adjustment per year. Results also suggest strong linkages between the agricultural and nonagricultural labor markets. Interstate agricultural productivity differences have risen substantially in the last twenty-five years, and many feel this has led to a disintegration of the agricultural labor market. The findings suggest an indirect integration may be occurring through migration to nonagriculture.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了印度农业劳动力市场对经济环境变化的调整速度。分析了1970–86年间16个邦的农业工资。结果表明，农业工资会快速向其长期水平调整，每年完成约五分之一至四分之一的调整。结果还表明，农业与非农劳动力市场之间存在紧密联系。过去二十五年间，各邦之间的农业生产率差异显著扩大，许多人认为这导致了农业劳动力市场的解体。研究结果表明，可能通过向非农业部门的迁移，出现了一种间接整合。

title: The Political Economy of Water Quality Protection from Agricultural Chemicals
venue: Northeastern Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: Growing evidence of surface-water and groundwater contamination has led to demands for federal and state water quality protection policies. Agriculture will be an important target of such policies. Numerous instances of surface-water and groundwater contamination by pesticides and fertilizers have been recorded, and one study estimates that the drinking water of 50 million people in the U.S. is potentially contaminated by agricultural chemicals (Hallberg, Nielsen and Lee).
abstract_zh: 地表水和地下水污染的证据日益增多，促使人们要求出台联邦和州级水质保护政策。农业将是此类政策的重要目标。已有大量地表水和地下水受农药和化肥污染的案例被记录在案，一项研究估计，美国有5000万人的饮用水可能受到农用化学品的污染（Hallberg, Nielsen and Lee）。

title: Cross Compliance and Water Quality Protection
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract:
THE most divisive issue in the coming debate on a new farm bill may well be water quality protection. Already there are many calls to extend the sodbuster, swampbuster, and especially the cross compliance provisions of the Food Security Act of 1985 to protect groundwater and surface water from agricultural pollutants. A bill recently introduced by Georgia Senator Wyche Fowler would require cross compliance in areas where groundwater has been contaminated by fertilizers or pesticides. Farms in these areas would be forced to develop and follow agricultural management plans or lose commodity program benefits. Needless to say, such proposals likely will meet stiff political resistance from farmers.
Missing in the debate up to this point is an answer to one simple question: Is cross compliance the best way to protect water quality from agricultural production practices? That is, will it bring about a permanent reduction in surface water and groundwater contamination in the areas where the problems are the most serious? We do not think it will.
The case against cross compliance
We recognize that the case against cross compliance is politically hard to make at this time. The appearance of cross compliance in the 1985 farm bill as a way to …
abstract_zh:
在即将到来的新一轮农业法案辩论中，最具争议的议题很可能是水质保护。目前已有众多呼声要求将1985年《食品安全法》中的sodbuster（草皮开垦）和swampbuster（沼泽保护）条款，尤其是交叉合规（cross compliance）条款，扩展至保护地下水和地表水免受农业污染物侵害。佐治亚州参议员怀彻·福勒（Wyche Fowler）近日提出的一项法案，要求在地下水已受化肥或农药污染的地区实行交叉合规。这些地区的农场若想保留商品计划补贴，就必须制定并执行农业管理计划。不言而喻，此类提案很可能会遭到农民的强烈政治抵制。
迄今为止，这场辩论中缺少对一个简单问题的回答：交叉合规是否是保护农业生产实践所致水质的最佳方式？也就是说，它能否在问题最为严重的地区永久性地减少地表水和地下水污染？我们认为它不能。
反对交叉合规的理由
我们承认，在当前形势下，反对交叉合规在政治上很难提出。交叉合规作为一种……出现在1985年农业法案中……

title: Vote Trading on Farm Legislation in the U.S. House
abstract: Several farm groups do not command enough votes in the U.S. House of Representatives to pass their programs without the help of others. This study investigates the extent of vote trading by these groups. Both vote trading among these groups and between them and representatives of the poor are examined. Farm legislation from 1985–86 is studied. The results show an active coalition among tobacco, sugar, peanut, and dairy farmers, as well as the poor. Wheat, rice, and cotton farmers are much less active in the coalition, while feed grain farmers are not in it at all.
abstract_zh: 若干农业团体在美国众议院中没有足够的票数，无法在没有其他团体帮助的情况下通过自身计划。本研究考察了这些团体进行投票交易的程度。我们考察了这些团体之间，以及它们与代表穷人的议员之间的投票交易。研究以1985–86年的农业立法为对象。结果显示，烟草、糖、花生和乳制品农民与穷人之间存在一个活跃的联盟。小麦、水稻和棉花农民在该联盟中的活跃度要低得多，而饲料谷物农民则完全不在其中。
